subject.title: bug(cost): mid-session writes to bootstrap-injected files trigger cacheWrite spiral on long agentic sessions; bootstrap-cache.ts shipped for #43532 is content-equality, not session-freeze

question: Should OpenClaw preserve live per-turn bootstrap visibility, or add an opt-in session-stable/bootstrap-dynamic cache contract for Anthropic cost control?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but each fix changes a durable prompt/cache/config contract and existing long-session semantics, so automation should not choose it unilaterally.

options.title: Add opt-in session freeze
options.body: Add a documented opt-in mode that freezes system-prompt bootstrap content for a session while keeping file-tool reads live, preserving current default behavior.

options.title: Use dynamic-file config
options.body: Keep bootstrap snapshots live and implement the configurable dynamic-file/order surface tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/65438.

options.title: Document live refresh as intended
options.body: Decline a new runtime mode and correct the docs/operator guidance to warn that writing stable bootstrap files mid-session can invalidate prompt-cache prefixes.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in session freeze
recommendation.body: Add a documented opt-in mode that freezes system-prompt bootstrap content for a session while keeping file-tool reads live, preserving current default behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the original bootstrap snapshot cache and made the public predecessor-close decision that this issue directly challenges.
